theme: the relief of not having to explain yourself on a dating app

days.x: tired of the silence after disclosing. is it me or the disability? #disabilitydating #able2love
days.instagram: The worst part of disclosing a disability on dating apps isn't the disclosure itself, but the silence that follows. It's like, you're waiting to see if that's the end of it. Some venues get it right, like the step-free club I went to last week, where everyone was dancing together, no fuss. Able2Love is free on Google Play, link in bio

days.x: ghosting isn't about me, it's about people running into the wrong people. still stings though #ghosting #disabilitydating
days.instagram: Ghosting isn't fun for anyone, but when you're disabled, it can feel like it's because of your disability. I've been there, and it's not true. People are just running into the wrong people, but it still hurts. That's why Able2Love exists, to make a change. Link in bio
